scope: Offline JavaScript reference precision arithmetic, frozen-reference trust boundary, native certificate qualification, engine/selection/model/endpoint scope, report unit conversion and strict diagnostic retention. This is not an input blind review, vendor arithmetic proof or end-to-end acceptance.

policy.comparison: abs(actual-reference) <= frozenAbsolute + gamma_(2*n-1) * sum(abs(canonicalTerms)) + frozenRelative * abs(reference)
policy.budgetSource: Only independently frozen reference engineeringPrecision; candidate-result uncertainty declarations are ignored.
policy.originalValuesAndTolerances: Comparator retains the original scalar and tolerance; strict pass/fail and failures are reported separately.
policy.qualifiedApplication: PKPM raw member inward endpoints from a single native basic case at factor one. Reaction, displacement, combination and derived propagation remain outside this policy.

findings.before: A missing/derived rawTrace and an interior member station could receive a recovery allowance. Reproduced with positionM=1.5 and nativeBasicFactors DL:2,LL:1.
findings.resolution: validatePrecisionScope checks original SDK endpoint trace, typed source selection, single source/native unit factors and raw term, node order/end/side; evaluation/reference/native validation additionally checks the actual frozen-model endpoint.
findings.verification: Reviewed current helper and all three call sites; new raw-scope and rehashed-certificate tests passed.

findings.before: PKPM scope was checked in reference readiness but not independently in the commercial native qualification gate.
findings.resolution: Native gate explicitly requires PKPM and no derived propagation, and binds trace nativeRun/model SHA and certificate recovery nativeRun to the state.
findings.verification: Added one YJK rehash regression. It passes on current sources and fails when only the native-gate PKPM condition is removed in an in-memory module.

checks: Precision metadata recomputes gamma, term count, absolute scale and allowance; finite numbers, fixed roundoff/policy flags and certificate digest are mandatory.
Candidate scoring projection equality includes precision metadata and raw trace; named native review binds the exact candidate and authored source.
Certificate must be present in retained native artifacts, hash-match, identify PKPM/case/source/state/typed selector, and match exact precision/location/component/unit and nativeRun.
Trace sourceModelSha256 is checked against current frozen model bytes; ordered sourceEndNodes, station and side are checked against model geometry.
Execution engine/model/state/source/result fingerprints and requested identity/unit/sign checks remain in place.
Report outputUnits scale value, absolute tolerance, canonical terms and recovery budget together; certificate digest remains the original frozen proof identity.
Primitive execution and report comparisons retain strict pass/fail alongside engineering-policy results.
No derived propagation is authorized; the current policy does not silently alter extrema/co-governor rules.

validation.test: YJK native gate rejects PKPM precision even after every enclosing binding is rehashed
validation.expectedFailure: nativeVerified became true; assertion expected false

changesByReviewer: Added only the YJK native-gate rehash negative test to lib/reference-precision-binding.test.cjs.
limitations: The policy explicitly widens engineering acceptance; it is not an inferred bound on opaque vendor arithmetic.
Certificate term generation and its physical evidence require the separate named numerical review; JavaScript verifies their binding and arithmetic metadata.
Sign cannot be distinguished mathematically when the declared acceptance interval straddles zero; the policy does not claim otherwise.
No full repository suite or remote/native solver was run for this review. No corpus, exporter or production JavaScript was edited by this reviewer.
